title.narrative: RA 1: Improved monitoring and evaluation capacities for implementation of regional commitments at regional and national level, including in terms of gender mainstreaming.

description.narrative: The 2021 2025 MTSP recognises monitoring and evaluation as an important function to support the successful implementation of the COMESA targeted activities and to ensure that the main goal of regional economic integration is attained. The Strategic Plan recognises that its successful implementation is largely dependent on how activities and expected results (outcomes and outputs) are effectively monitored and evaluated. It envisages that the plans monitoring will be undertaken through institutional arrangements both at Member States and Secretariat levels. The monitoring and evaluation function will be facilitated using various tools and mechanisms guided by the developed M&E Framework with clearly defined indicators including those on gender. COMESA has planned also to develop an M&E manual a document that describes a system which links strategic information obtained from various data collection systems to decisions that will improve strategic directions. This manual will be instrumental in ensuring consensus on M&E approaches and uses of data/ information products generated from the M&E Systems. It not only ensures standardization and coordination of M&E practices but also outlines responsibility and encourages transparency.

title.narrative: RA3: Strengthened ability to produce and disseminate regional statistics in line with the COMESA Statistics Strategy ensuring harmonisation and gender responsiveness.

description.narrative: The COMESA Statistics Strategys (CSS 20172020) tenure ended in 2020. Paris21 and AfDB were involved in the midterm review while the former also led in the end term review of the strategy. While COMESAs overall score for implementation and achievement of the CSS 20172020 was 78%, the reviews also exposed gaps in areas such as human capacity to provide the needed statistical support to all COMESA programs as captured by the MTSP and the Treaty. COMESA is currently finalizing the next CSS for the period 20212025. This new strategy has two main strategic objectives: firstly, to strengthen statistics that support all the pillars of the new MTSP 20212025 and secondly to strengthen strategic partnerships in statistical development. Specifically, under R3, focus will be to respond to strengthening statistics to support the MTSP 20212025s strategic objectives as well as responding to the need to strengthen partnerships in mutual areas of interest in statistical development on the continent through the SHaSA 2 and other global statistical frameworks.
